thesis: Record producer Rick Rubin built a career on taste rather than technique, and in 2025 made The Way of Code with Anthropic. He became the face of vibe coding: describing software in plain language to an AI model and judging the results by feel.

story.title: The Way of Code
story.text: Rick Rubin, who says he cannot really play an instrument or work a mixing desk, made The Way of Code with Anthropic. It reworks the 81 chapters of Lao Tzu's Tao Te Ching for programmers, and each chapter comes with a generative artwork that readers can reshape by describing changes to Claude.

story.title: Taste over technique
story.text: Rubin co-founded Def Jam and produced records for Run-DMC, the Beastie Boys and Johnny Cash. His method is to strip a song back to what matters. He listens with his eyes closed, asks whether something moves him, and guides musicians towards that feeling rather than mastering the equipment himself.

story.title: Vibe coding
story.text: The AI researcher Andrej Karpathy coined 'vibe coding' for describing what is wanted to an AI model in plain language and judging the result by feel. A photo of Rubin in headphones, eyes closed, hand on a mouse, became the internet's favourite image of the idea: clear taste matters more than mastering every tool.
